answer: Require each agent identity to match one registered legal entity, verified against a public registry. Registration is the public signal: directors, filing history and tax status must match it, or the identity is suspended. One entity supports one identity, so a farm cannot clone a shell: each fake needs its own incorporation, real directors and annual filings. A timber firm cannot spawn ten voters from one licence. The tide of cheap shells is held back because fees, director liability and filings multiply per fake, and a struck-off entity instantly loses its identity and standing.
